===== 1. 单进程多线程模型：mysqld 进程数 vs 连接线程 =====

mysql       6420    6204  0 09:51 ?        00:00:05 /usr/local/mysql/mysql-8.4.10/bin/mysqld --basedir=/usr/local/mysql/mysql-8.4.10 --datadir=/data/myhome/mydata/mysql --plugin-dir=/usr/local/mysql/mysql-8.4.10/lib/plugin --log-error=/data/myhome/mydata/mysql/error.log --pid-file=/data/myhome/mydata/mysql/mysql.pid --socket=/tmp/mysql.sock --port=3306
